description: This bar chart illustrates F1 scores for different models across four datasets. The horizontal axis represents the datasets—PSM, SwaT, SMAP, and MSL—listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “F1 Score (%)”, displays values on a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each dataset, there are four bars representing different model configurations: “MADLLM” (light green), “MADLLM w/o feature embedding” (darker green), “MADLLM w/o skip embedding” (light purple), and “MADLLM w/o embedding” (light orange).  For the PSM dataset, the bar heights are approximately 92%, 97%, 94%, and 88% respectively. For SwaT, the bar heights are approximately 83%, 91%, 88%, and 85%. For SMAP, the bar heights are approximately 87%, 94%, 91%, and 90%. For MSL, the bar heights are approximately 91%, 95%, 93%, and 92%. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each group containing one bar for each model configuration. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not appear to be sorted by any particular order within the groups.
